d: Our client, a growing fintech company in Kuwait, is looking to hire a dedicated Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Compliance Specialist to support its regulatory compliance framework and ensure adherence to applicable financial regulations and standards. The company operates in the financial technology sector, with a focus on making investment more accessible. The successful candidate will play an important role in maintaining compliance, mitigating financial crime risks, and promoting ethical and transparent financial practices. We are looking for a detail-oriented professional with relevant AML and compliance experience who can contribute to strengthening the company's compliance operations within Kuwait's evolving fintech landscape.
Develop, monitor, and enforce AML and CTF policies and procedures in alignment with local (CMA, CBK) and international regulatory requirements.
Perform customer due diligence (CDD) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) for high-risk accounts to mitigate financial crime risks.
Oversee transaction monitoring systems and analyze alerts to detect and report suspicious activities.
Prepare and submit Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) to the Kuwait Financial Intelligence Unit (KFIU) and other relevant authorities.
Collaborate with internal teams to integrate compliance protocols into client onboarding and daily trading workflows.
Conduct regular AML risk assessments and provide training to staff to maintain a culture of compliance.
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Law, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
3–5 years of professional experience in AML/CTF compliance within a fintech, brokerage, or regulated financial institution.
In-depth knowledge of local and international regulatory frameworks including CMA, CBK, FATF, and OFAC.
Proven experience with digital KYC solutions and transaction monitoring software.
Professional certification such as CAMS or ICA is highly preferred.

d: GSS Tech Group is hiring a Senior Android Engineer for a leading bank in the UAE. You will join a team building a large scale, multi module Android banking application used by millions of customers, and you will help bring AI powered features into the app.

This role is for an engineer who is strong in modern Android architecture and who has built and shipped LLM features inside an Android app. You will work across feature teams to keep the codebase scalable, fast and stable, while integrating conversational and agentic AI capabilities safely into a regulated banking environment
q: 6+ years of hands on Android development with Kotlin
Proven experience shipping at least one LLM or AI powered feature inside an Android app in production (for example, an in app assistant, chatbot, AI search or recommendations)
Strong Jetpack Compose experience in production
Experience working on a multi module Android codebase, with a clear understanding of how modules are structured and connected
Solid Gradle knowledge, including build configuration and build performance
Hilt or Dagger for dependency injection
Hands on experience with Crashlytics, memory profiling and ANR diagnosis
Expertise in at least two of the following:
Banking, fintech or payments app experience
MCP server or tool integration experience
Experience with Firebase AI Logic, Vertex AI or Gemini Nano on Android
Mobile security practices: SSL pinning, Android Keystore, Play Integrity, OAuth 2.0 with PKCE
What We Look For in Your CV
To help us review your profile quickly, please include
The AI feature you built in an Android app: what it does, which model or API it uses, and roughly how many users it serves
Measurable results, for example: crash free rate, ANR reduction, rendering or startup improvements, build time improvements
The scale of the codebase you worked on, for example: number of modules, team size, user base
r: Build and maintain a large scale, multi module Android application using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose
Design scalable Gradle architectures, including feature modules, API and implementation separation, convention plugins and version catalogs
Improve build performance using build cache, configuration cache, KSP and modularization strategies
Apply strong dependency injection patterns using Hilt or Dagger so code stays testable across feature teams
Define and enforce architecture standards (Clean Architecture, MVVM or MVI, unidirectional data flow)
Implement and monitor Firebase Crashlytics and maintain a high crash free user rate
Diagnose and resolve ANRs, memory leaks and performance bottlenecks using Android Studio Profiler, LeakCanary, Perfetto and Macrobenchmark
Build high performance Compose UIs and optimize recomposition and rendering
Integrate LLM APIs (such as OpenAI, Gemini or Claude) into production Android features
Work with MCP (Model Context Protocol) frameworks and tool calling to connect AI models with app and backend services
Manage tokens, context windows and conversation history efficiently
Build agentic workflows and contribute to multi agent orchestration where needed
Design AI error recovery: timeouts, rate limits, invalid or unsafe responses, and graceful fallback to standard app flows
Make sure AI features meet banking standards for security, privacy and data protection
Work closely with product, design, backend, QA and security teams
Review code, mentor engineers and contribute to technical decisions

Nozomi Networks is the leader in OT and IoT cybersecurity, keeping the world's critical infrastructure cyber resilient through real-time asset visibility, threat detection, and AI-powered analysis. We protect the toughest operational environments — from energy and healthcare to manufacturing and beyond.
Now is an amazing time to join Nozomi Networks as we build the future of OT and IoT cybersecurity.

We defend some of the world’s largest organizations and critical infrastructure in more than 68 countries and we’re just getting started. Our AI-powered cybersecurity platform secures operational technology (OT) and Internet of Things (IoT) infrastructures for enterprises and government entities across energy, manufacturing, transportation, resources, and critical infrastructure.

As we expand our product portfolio and global presence, our Customer Success department is hiring a Customer Success Manager to engage and build meaningful relationships with our Critical Accounts driving a high level of customer satisfaction, successful product use, and customer retention. You will serve as the primary point of contact for key customers, understand customer success criteria, drive adoption & value realization, address questions, resolve issues and grow into a trusted customer advocate.

For the right candidate, this is a career-defining opportunity to join Nozomi at a crucial moment and have a truly significant impact. The ideal candidate should have a proven track record of exceptional account management, maintaining high customer renewal rates as a result of ongoing customer engagement, technical leadership, and outstanding communication skills.
If this sounds like you, read on. You could be the next "Nozomier"!
q: Emotional Intelligence (EQ), Interpersonal skills and Empathy
r: Own and drive the customer lifecycle – protect, nurture and deliver exceptional service to all customers.
Drive revenue growth by demonstrating successful achievement of customer guided value measures
Minimize customer churn through customer success plans and customer lifecycle management.
Resolve customer requests and concerns ensuring improvements to customer experience.
Improve customer experience through data and trend analysis, ensuring relevant reporting to influence communication and engagement strategies with the customer and internally.
Maintain customer information accuracy to ensure that internal stakeholders always have clean data and customer information.
Be a reliable point of contact and brand ambassador for Nozomi and its products.
Work across departments ensuring proper customer visibility and outcomes are met.
Aid in product design and product development through customer feedback.
Assist in creating training courses and educational materials for other members of the department.
Evaluate and improve tutorials and other communication infrastructure.
To Be Successful In This Opportunity, You Will Have
2+ years of proven experience in a customer success position supporting a technical product
Demonstrable experience onboarding customers, driving adoption and consistently achieving business outcomes
Deep understanding of customers concerns and thoughts regarding the use of products, recommending operational best practices, and the ability to troubleshoot as needed.
Strong organizational skills with strong experience creating/maintaining account notes, developing and executing get-well plans and customer success playbooks
3+ years of experience in IT and network security (OT experience is a plus)
Technical skills - confidently conduct product demos, training and present technical reports to customers articulating value delivered
Previous experience in a TAM or SE role is highly valuable
Experience working with brand image and promoting value through customer experience
Accountability, personal organization, and ability to multi-task.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills – able to compile and deliver technical reports and executive level presentations
Leadership and Competency engaging with CxO to technical staff.
Experience analyzing and optimizing processes in the Customer Success department.
